title: Journey detail
description: The detailed specification of a single journey. Owned by the journey, not by any capability. Phases decompose the journey into ordered steps; paths describe the happy, alternative, and exception flows through those phases. Entities, services, and events are referenced by ID — they are defined canonically in capability-scoped data-model, service-boundaries, and event-catalogue artifacts, not here.

journey_id.description: Reference to the journey this artefact details. Must match the journey folder it lives in.

name.description: Human-readable journey name. Should match the name in the journey inventory.

description.description: Expanded description of the journey. Optional here; the authoritative short description is in the journey inventory.

status.description: Lifecycle status of this detailed specification.

triggering_persona.description: The primary persona who initiates the journey.

capabilities_touched.description: Capabilities exercised by this journey. Must match the inventory entry.

phases.description: Ordered list of phases decomposing the journey. Each phase represents a distinct step with its own entry/exit conditions.

id.description: Stable unique phase identifier within this journey.

actors.description: Personas or roles that participate in this phase.

channels.description: Channels through which actors interact with the capability in this phase.

services.description: Services involved in executing this phase. Defined canonically in technical-service files.

governance_rules.description: Governance rule IDs (e.g. GOV-XXX) applicable to this phase. Resolution to rule definitions is pack-specific.

entry_conditions.description: Preconditions that must hold before the phase may begin.

exit_conditions.description: Postconditions produced by successful completion of the phase.

exit_conditions_failure.description: Named failure conditions and their handling.

paths.description: The flows through the phases. Every journey has a happy path with at least one phase. Alternative paths describe valid variants; exception paths describe failure-handling flows.

description.description: Prose description of the happy path.

phases.description: Ordered list of phase IDs making up the happy path.

alternative_paths.description: Valid variant flows. Empty array permitted.
